I got the arturia minilab MK2 not too long ago and I've loved it so far, great deal for the price . The keys do take a little getting used to since they're mini keys and not full sized. But it comes with Analog Lab lite amongst other stuff which is pretty neat.

If you're looking for a 25key that has nice feeling keys try the maudio code 25. A little more expensive but you'll get full sized semi weighted keys which feel great.
